scenario.title: Instant noodle line: flow production with QC rework
scenario.story: Every plant has quality rework, the question is whether it flows or breaks the line. Acme's noodle line runs three shifts producing Instant Noodles 100g, a process-order product with a semi-finished dough intermediate. A recent batch of curly noodles failed final visual QC 8% of the time last month, and that rework disappears into spreadsheets. This demo shows operators confirming completions via NFC badge tap and the rework path surfacing as a first-class queue item so the supervisor's board stays honest. The line supervisor watches a failed QC batch route automatically to the rework queue and a certified operator pick it up without a phone call. Without DM, rework hides in spreadsheets and operators lose track after failed QC.
